notes: NAME ENTRY (original scene 22: create 0x2c614, init 0x2c8cb, controls 0x2cd21 and 0x2d194, animation 0x2ca50 and 0x2cb9e, draw 0x2d9ca, end 0x2d5f9, check 0x2d723, message 0x2d7ac).

pages are Alphabet, Symbols and End (0x1f99e8, 15 x 6 characters each; End has no grid). Row 6 is the tab row: the D-pad moves between the tabs there, and a tab is chosen as soon as the cursor lands on it.

confirm types the character under the cursor (or ends the entry on End); typing at the last place replaces it. delete removes the last character, space adds one, page_back and page_forward change page, wrapping only on a new press. end jumps to the End tab (the original's B/BACK mask 0x220).
A name of only spaces is no name: the notice opens and the name is emptied (0x2d723). Otherwise the screen fades out to exit_to and the name is kept.

animation: after the fade in the grid and tabs fade in (intro_per_second); halfway, the controls box slides in from slide_from to slide_to, then its button hints fade in. Once the box passes grow_below_x the name box grows (10 frames: wider than full, then taller) and the label and name appear. Each page's characters fade in when it is chosen, the previous page's out.
The cursors pulse: alpha is sin(phase) x 128 / 255, the phase going up 0.05 a frame and wrapping at pi (0x2e360). The grid cursor shows only on the grid.
The colums step with sys entry 4, rows with 3; a page change plays 9, typing and space 5, delete 21.

Scene 22 starts no music of its own (tables/music.json scene_music is -1), so the track playing carries on: from NEW GAME that is event 48's Awake to Love. It runs the radio (0x2c74b, data/audio/radio.json), so once the music stops another song from the playlist follows.

frame: the day and money (0x2e337: data/ui/frame.json), the music meter in the band's slots and the CURRENT MUSIC credit along y 419 (0x2c7c8: 0x2a85a at 0, 419, 23 characters) while a credited track plays.

labels: NAME ENTRY names the player (mode 0, label), a dealer's new CHIP (mode 2, labels.chip: 0x3ad84 names the CHIP's stock entry) or a battle music program (mode 3, labels.program); the label sprites are 0x1f96c0's, by mode.

Where the entry leads depends on the scene that opened it (0xa2e70): exits maps the screen before it to the next one, exit_to is the rest. After event 48 it is Pepper's guide (scene 19), which event 49 leads into.
